Hi Liz — thanks for the materials and the clear sample. Short answers up front, then a recommended path so we can operationalize it: 

1) Multi-PO invoices
- Preferred: one invoice file per PO for automated PO-matching.
- Acceptable fallback: single consolidated CSV with a PO column on each lineitem (we can ingest but it increases manual reconciliation risk).

2) Email fallback routing
- If you must use email, include the subject token: Redwood-PO:<PO_NUMBER> for single-PO invoices.
- For consolidated files, use: Redwood-Consolidated:<VENDOR_ID>:<BILL_CYCLE>. Our ingestion will parse those tokens and route to the correct ledger.

3) PO-stamping vs CSV PO field
- If submitting PDFs, we prefer the PO stamped on the document body AND included in any embedded CSV metadata. If you can't stamp PDFs, ensure the CSV lineitems contain the PO column with exact match to our PO format (e.g., RW-123456).

4) Tax/VAT fields
- Required fields: billing_entity, tax_id (VAT/GST), tax_amount (per line optional), currency. 
- Optional but helpful: tax_breakdown (percent), tax_region.

Recommended onboarding path (to minimize exceptions):
- Step 1: Complete our onboarding form (link below).
- Step 2: Pilot portal upload for 3 pay runs. Our portal will return an ack token per file within 5 minutes.
- Step 3: If portal issues arise, use the agreed fallback subject tokens for email ingestion for up to 30 days. After migration we expect portal-only.

Monica (cc'd), can you confirm the ack SLA (5 min) and the exact subject token parsing rules to include in the onboarding checklist? Vanessa — please confirm acceptable grace for consolidated CSVs during pilot.

I'll book a short post-pilot check-in.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Liz — Vanessa from Finance Ops here. Quick confirmation and operational note so your tech team can configure: 

- Ack token: unique per uploaded file (we return ack_token=RW-ACK-<timestamp>-<vendor_id>) — this is the canonical receipt for reconciliation.
- PO matching: our pipeline accepts PO on either line-level PO column or invoice header PO field; line-level is preferred when invoices include mixed POs.
- Subject tokens: please use one of the following exact formats when emailing as fallback:
  * Single-PO PDF: subject = "Redwood-PO:RW-<six_digits>"
  * Consolidated CSV: subject = "Redwood-Consolidated:VENDOR-<vendor_id>:BATCH-<yyyymmdd>"

Operational exception: we will allow consolidated CSV email fallback for up to 30 days after go-live. After that, portal-only ingestion for new invoices.
